deviation: The research-tree recipe used `--graph_types go string pxmap-top1 txmap-top1`. Dropping pxmap and txmap is an UNCONTROLLED deviation from the configuration every prior finding was measured on: it buys portability and costs the claim 'same graph set as the prior work'. Recorded here and in the benchmark card.
redistribution: THIRD-PARTY DATA. Not ours to publish: it must not go to HuggingFace and is gitignored. scripts/check_upload_gate.py must keep refusing it.
why: Prior-knowledge graphs for the virtual-cell perturbation embedding. Copied rather than symlinked so the benchmark is self-contained on any machine. Only the two graphs the recipe uses (go, string) plus the master gene set are copied; the source tree is 12 GB and includes pxmap/txmap/reactome/afm/depmap/revolution, which this benchmark does not use.
